# Scientific thinking. Mathematical modelling. Data and AI.

I work across disciplines and engineering contexts: from mathematical and environmental modelling in research settings to software delivery, industrial Data Science, and evaluation of AI systems.

This portfolio is a curated account of that path. It connects scientific questions, methods, implementation choices, technologies, and evidence. It is not a catalogue of every technology encountered: each project is described at the level supported by a publication, public repository, or clearly stated professional experience. Work from private industrial projects is summarised without exposing proprietary code, data, or implementation details.

## A multidisciplinary profile

- **Mathematics and science:** partial differential equations, applied mathematics, statistics, fluid mechanics, environmental dispersion, and infiltration-related modelling.
- **Research and experimentation:** problem formulation, model assumptions, numerical modelling, evaluation protocols, baselines, error analysis, and interpretation of results.
- **Software engineering:** application development across front-end and back-end systems, maintainable code, testing, integration, and deployment environments.
- **Data and AI:** statistical analysis, classical machine learning, LLM/NLP and generative AI, benchmark design, and model evaluation.

The connecting skill is adaptation: understanding the scientific or product problem first, then selecting and implementing an appropriate method in the constraints of the environment.
